candidate.definition_en: A male holding the highest hereditary title in the British and certain other peerages.
candidate.explanation_ar: لقب نبيل عالي جداً في بريطانيا، بيجي تحت الملك والأمير على طول.

senses.definition_en: A male holding the highest hereditary title in the British and certain other peerages.
senses.explanation_ar: لقب نبيل عالي جداً في بريطانيا، بيجي تحت الملك والأمير على طول.
examples: He was officially given the title of duke by the monarch.
The duke owned several vast estates across the countryside.
A foreign duke arrived at the royal court to negotiate a treaty.
